Coursework list

/courses/:courseId/coursework
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S03, S05, S10

List assignments and quizzes with consistent personal dates, attempt states and release status. Staff context may navigate authoring or grading without leaking staff-only values into learner rows.

Stay on courseworkOpen chosen editor
Permissions
  • Learners see only eligible published assessments and their own group/individual status.
  • TA sees allocated grading navigation; no policy/release shortcuts.
  • Staff due-to-grade dates do not replace student submission dates.
Responsive
  • Dense list becomes labelled cards; retain title, personal deadline and status.
  • Filter controls wrap with a Clear filters action.
Accessibility
  • Table uses headers or cards with repeated labels, never visual alignment alone.
  • Sort changes announce result count and preserve focus.
Data
  • Assessment summary/type/category and published dates.
  • Personal allowance, latest receipt reference, group mode and release availability.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Personal extension ordering agrees with W07 and W19.
  • Held staff score never appears in a learner row or filter count.
  • List failure cannot incorrectly label every assignment missing or not received.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
